name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a shaman, you complete the trial of fire in Khaz Modan and earn the Fire Totem. It lets you channel flame and commune with the fire spirits.
As a dwarf, you carry the flame from the heights above Loch Modan into Dun Morogh. The journey joins your spiritual seeking to the elemental forces of your mountain home.
Within Alliance lands in Khaz Modan, spiritual callings take root. Bruegs Kindleborn guides new initiates as they learn the elemental arts.

aliases: what do you do in call of fire
faq.answer: Call of Fire is a spiritual trial for shamans in Khaz Modan. The initiate lights the Torch of Eternal Flame at a brazier overlooking Loch Modan, then carries it through the mountains to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: What is the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Bruegs Kindleborn is an elemental mentor who lives in Dun Morogh. He oversees the rites of flame and gives initiates who complete the trek their Fire Totem.

aliases: what is torch of eternal flame
where do you get the torch
faq.answer: The Torch of Eternal Flame is a ceremonial torch lit at a brazier overlooking Loch Modan. It marks an initiate's bond with elemental fire and must be carried safely to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: What is the Torch of Eternal Flame?

aliases: what reward for call of fire
faq.answer: When you deliver the Torch of Eternal Flame safely to Bruegs Kindleborn, he acknowledges your blazing spirit and gives you your Fire Totem. The totem marks you as flameborn.
faq.q: What do you receive upon completing this trial?

aliases: where does call of fire take place
faq.answer: The journey begins at an overlook above Loch Modan, where the torch is lit. The mountain path leads into Dun Morogh, where Bruegs Kindleborn awaits.
faq.q: Where does this journey take place?

faq.answer: Bruegs mentions Madoran in an oath, referring to Madoran Bronzebeard. He was the revered dwarven leader who led the Bronzebeard clan during the War of the Three Hammers.

sections.body: An initiate lights the Torch of Eternal Flame on a mountain ridge above Loch Modan. The flame marks the beginning of a deeper bond with the elements. From there, the initiate carries it down the trails and into the snowy vales of Dun Morogh.
sections.title: The Flame Over the Loch

sections.body: In Dun Morogh, Bruegs Kindleborn awaits the traveler. He is an elemental mentor who judges whether the traveler's inner fire has taken hold. The blazing torch proves the initiate's will and reverence for fire. Bruegs then grants the Fire Totem, welcoming the flameborn into a lineage of elemental guidance for their kin.
sections.title: The Flameborn's Reward

summary: Above Loch Modan, an initiate kindles the flame that must reach Dun Morogh. Bruegs Kindleborn awaits its return and judges the traveler's command of the elements.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
